title: add downgrade guard + pre-upgrade backup/restore hooks and schema migration safety
author: Priya Nambiar
description:
Motivation: Upgrades for private deployments must be reversible and safe across heterogeneous customer environments. This PR adds an explicit downgrade guard to the installer, integrates pre-upgrade backup hooks (etcd + Postgres), improves Postgres schema migration idempotency checks, and updates Helm and Terraform modules to pin operator and chart versions used during upgrades. The goal is to reduce upgrade rollbacks and provide a deterministic, auditable upgrade path for on-prem and VPC installs.

What this change does (high level):
- installer: new --enforce-downgrade-guard flag that prevents applying manifests if target version is older than currently deployed version unless --force-downgrade is passed and a valid backup snapshot is present.
- backup/restore: adds pre-upgrade backup hooks for etcd (for control plane) and Postgres (k8s Job + S3-compatible snapshotter integration), and an idempotent restore flow used by the rollback command.
- migrations: migration runner now records migration checksums and includes a dry-run validation step that runs in a read-only transaction where supported. Adds a reversible-marker to migrations where possible.
- Helm charts: chart values now include an explicit chart_version and operator_image: the installer templates pin the chart+image during upgrades to avoid accidental implicit downgrades from upstream churn.
- Terraform: module updates and examples to show how to pin provider versions and module versions for the private installer (private_network, db_subnet, bastion).
- CI: adds e2e smoke scenario for upgrade -> backup -> rollback using KinD and ephemeral S3 backend.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add downgrade guard flag and tests
- [x] Implement pre-upgrade backup jobs for etcd and Postgres
- [x] Add migration checksum recording and reversible markers
- [x] Update Helm charts to expose chart_version/operator_image pinning
- [x] Update Terraform examples and module version constraints
- [x] Add e2e smoke test for upgrade backup/rollback
- [x] Add docs + release notes

Related: Linear ENG-1942 (upgrade safety), ENG-2031 (private-installer rollback UX), PM-4112 (customer upgrade playbook).
commits: 5 commits: 1) add backup/restore job templates and S3 snapshotter integration; 2) add migration checksum recorder and dry-run validation; 3) helm chart: add chart_version/operator_image values and template pinning; 4) installer: implement --enforce-downgrade-guard and --force-downgrade with snapshot validation; 5) terraform: examples and module version constraints + docs

release_notes: Added downgrade guard to installer; pre-upgrade backups for etcd and Postgres; pinned helm chart and operator image versions during upgrades; improved migration safety with checksum recording and dry-run validation; Terraform examples updated to pin provider/module versions. See docs/private-installer/upgrade-playbook.md for operator guidance.
notes_for_ops: Operator: when running upgrades for customers with >1TB DB, schedule maintenance window - Postgres backup can take significant time.
If --force-downgrade is used, a valid pre-upgrade snapshot must be provided; rollback will refuse to proceed without snapshot verification.
Terraform: pin module versions in production to avoid implicit provider upgrades during infrastructure changes.
